record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, retain the shared 128-dimensional item table but replace strict unit normalization with e_i=(0.75+0.5*sigmoid(a_i))*normalize(v_i), using one jointly trained scalar a_i per item initialized to zero. Bounded learned norms may capture item-specific confidence while preserving tied input/output representations, unlike the regressed untied tables. Keep padding zero and preserve features, GRU topology, history policy, readout, dot-product scoring, loss and optimizer. Update the predictor writer to load matching checkpoints.

category_rationales.rationale: Learn bounded item-specific norms between 0.75 and 1.25, initialized at 1.0, while retaining the shared 128-dimensional input/output embedding table. This may capture item-specific confidence while preserving the GRU backbone, scoring, loss, optimizer and history policy across all four datasets.
